logs.adapter_compromise: numeric level counts plus total count; no full-month Drain3 template learning

resume_cache.policy: source-metadata and grid bound; atomic publish; execution-only and excluded from Git

metric.schema_rule: filename/service registry only; labels are unavailable to mapping

normalization_firewall: all telemetry scaling and quality decisions fit on Train only

preprocessing_runtime.pool_policy: metric, log, span, and trace pools execute sequentially

traces.span_lookup: two independent stable uint64 hashes; label-free parent span to service mapping
traces.timestamp_alignment: trace end_time to 30-second detector bin (historical Ada-MGAD convention)
